title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode1 Opening

rows.Line: I wanted to see my sister smile.

Saki missed school a lot because of her poor health,
                    so I was always thinking of
                         ways to cheer her up.

But there was little I could do
         at that tender age.
One day, our parents took us to a show.
I'll never forget what happened that day.

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Wow! So cool!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Did you see how cool that person was, Tsukasa?! They're all sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah, that was really, really cool!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I haven't seen Saki smile like this in forever!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And it's not just Saki... That main performer's singing and dancing is putting a huge smile on mom and dad's faces too!)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That must be why they call the performer in the leading role a star!)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: This is so much fun! I never want it to end... If only we could watch this every day!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: I know we can't because I'm not strong enough to go outside much...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know! If we can't go to the show, then...
Some years later
Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This day...is finally upon us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Clear skies and great weather...
Even the heavens are celebrating my debut into stardom!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha! At this rate, they'll take one look at me during the audition and immediately accept my application!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Mom said she wants you to keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. Keep it down? I'm just warming up...my vocal cords by talking to the wall!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you're saying you were talking to the wall?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, you're going for an interview for that new part-time job today, right? I hope it goes well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not an interview...an audition!
It sounds cooler that way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! That's what you're concerned about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
By the way...how's school so far, Saki?
You only just got better, so don't overdo it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, but I'm perfectly fine!
I'm gonna live my high school life to the fullest to make up for lost time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm glad that you're one step closer to your dream of becoming a star! You've always wanted that, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually... When did you start dreaming of becoming a star, anyway?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You've been talking about it for as long as I can remember.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why did I want to become a star, you ask?
Needless to say, that's because... Ahh...why indeed, actually?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? You don't remember yourself?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-I'm just having a temporary lapse of memory!
Okay, let's see... Let's see... Of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because it would be such a terrible tragedy to let my awesome stage talent go to waste!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Reeeally?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha... When you put it that way, I can't help but think that has to be it! It's like you were born for this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-You understand me, Saki!
And that's why this audition I'm going for is as good as passed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And then I'll become the biggest and brightest star ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Did my phone just light up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did it? More importantly, shouldn't you be preparing to head out soon? Good luck out there, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let me see...no new messages. Strange...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Seriously, though... Why did I set out to become a star, anyway? I feel like I'm forgetting something really important here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What's this?
Untitled?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! It's so bright?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Is this...a stage?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay... I was in my room, and when I played that song, it suddenly... This is a dream or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Strange-looking stage props of all sizes are scattered all about... What sort of show are they performing here?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And also...why does that stage feel so...nostalgic?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey☆, Tsukasa!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wha?! Who?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm Miku!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Miku? As in Hatsune Miku?
Well, I guess you do have the look down pat...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't forget about me, Tsukasa! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa... KAITO?! Miku and KAITO at the same time? This can only mean one thing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm having the strangest dream of my life!
But here's something even stranger... When did I even fall asleep?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is your SEKAI, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! This SEKAI is a world that was born from your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Born from...my feelings? Wh-What's that supposed to even mean? How absurd! And even if that was true, why would you two be here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku and I are here because we want to help you find your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you find your true feelings, songs will be born from them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, yes... It's clear to me now that feelings will naturally transform into songs when...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Clear as mud, that is!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nooo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Besides, my true feelings have always been to become the world's top star!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that's part of it, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you remember what made you want to become a star to begin with, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What made me... Because, you know...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: When I become the world's top star, I'll be able to use my talent to put on the world's best show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh huh, and then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And then when people come see my show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah? What about them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All eyes will be drawn to the brightest star there: me! Once they see me, they'll certainly cry tears of joy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yea—ohhh...
I knew it... You've completely forgotten.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Poor Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What is it?
What have I done to deserve those pitiful stares?!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry about that. But I really hope you find your true feelings again, no matter how long it takes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, if you ever find this SEKAI somewhat nostalgic, please...hold on to those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nostalgic? Why would I find it nostalgic?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Come with everyone else next time, Tsukasa!
Let's all sing and dance in a show together☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone else has the same feelings as you too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who's this everyone else you're talking about? Why am I getting more questions than answers?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry! As long as you want to find your true feelings, we'll meet again soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye for now, Tsukasa! Until we meet again☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what?! We'll meet again? Wh-What does that—

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I fell asleep? That was a really strange dream, too... Something about a super hyper Hatsune Miku and...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! You're still here?
You're going to be late for that job interview if you keep dawdling!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-I know that! Also, it's not an interview!
It's an audition!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Like, who cares what it's called!
Just hurry up and go before you're late!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew... I really thought I'd be late, but my speedy feet have saved the day and I'm right on schedule! Go me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph... Today, I'm taking my first big step on the path to stardom! I'll start my career by drawing the most attention to myself during this audition!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My stage is calling to me!
